sql.query: SELECT w.id,w.workflowName,w.referenceCode,w.eventStatusId,es.statusName AS status,w.ownerTeamId,w.startDate,w.targetDate,w.locationId,w.spaceId,w.configurationId,w.rowVersion FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_event_statuses es ON es.id=w.eventStatusId AND es.tenantId=w.tenantId WHERE w.id=:id AND w.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants membership WHERE membership.userId=:userId AND membership.tenantId=w.tenantId AND membership.isActive=1 AND membership.membershipStatus='active') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles editRole INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions editGrant ON editGrant.roleId=editRole.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions editPermission ON editPermission.id=editGrant.permissionId AND editPermission.permissionCode='workflows.edit' AND editPermission.isActive=1 WHERE editRole.userId=:userId AND editRole.tenantId=w.tenantId AND editRole.isActive=1) LIMIT 1

UPDATE tbl_workflows w SET w.workflowName=:workflowName,w.referenceCode=NULLIF(:referenceCode,''),w.notes=NULLIF(:notes,''),w.eventStatusId=(SELECT status.id FROM tbl_event_statuses status WHERE status.id=:eventStatusId AND status.tenantId=w.tenantId AND (status.isActive=1 OR status.id=w.eventStatusId) LIMIT 1),w.ownerTeamId=(SELECT team.id FROM tbl_teams team WHERE team.id=NULLIF(:ownerTeamId,'') AND team.tenantId=w.tenantId AND team.isActive=1 LIMIT 1),w.workflowTypeId=(SELECT type.id FROM tbl_workflow_types type WHERE type.id=NULLIF(:workflowTypeId,'') AND type.tenantId=w.tenantId AND type.isActive=1 LIMIT 1),w.contractingEntityId=COALESCE((SELECT entity.id FROM tbl_contracting_entities entity WHERE entity.id=NULLIF(:contractingEntityId,'') AND entity.tenantId=w.tenantId AND entity.isActive=1 LIMIT 1),(SELECT defaultEntity.id FROM tbl_contracting_entities defaultEntity WHERE defaultEntity.tenantId=w.tenantId AND defaultEntity.isDefault=1 AND defaultEntity.isActive=1 LIMIT 1)),w.locationId=(SELECT location.id FROM tbl_locations location WHERE location.id=NULLIF(:locationId,'') AND location.tenantId=w.tenantId LIMIT 1),w.spaceId=(SELECT space.id FROM tbl_spaces space WHERE space.id=NULLIF(:spaceId,'') AND space.locationId=NULLIF(:locationId2,'') AND space.tenantId=w.tenantId LIMIT 1),w.configurationId=(SELECT configuration.id FROM tbl_space_configurations configuration WHERE configuration.id=NULLIF(:configurationId,'') AND configuration.spaceId=NULLIF(:spaceId2,'') AND configuration.tenantId=w.tenantId LIMIT 1),w.startDate=NULLIF(:startDate,''),w.targetDate=NULLIF(:targetDate,''),w.completedDate=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_event_statuses status WHERE status.id=:eventStatusId2 AND status.tenantId=w.tenantId AND status.systemCategory='completed') THEN COALESCE(w.completedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END,w.rowVersion=w.rowVersion+1,w.modifiedByUserId=:modifiedByUserId,w.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE w.id=:id AND w.tenantId=:tenantId AND w.rowVersion=:rowVersion AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_event_statuses status WHERE status.id=:validEventStatusId AND status.tenantId=w.tenantId AND (status.isActive=1 OR status.id=w.eventStatusId)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants membership WHERE membership.userId=:permissionUserId AND membership.tenantId=w.tenantId AND membership.isActive=1 AND membership.membershipStatus='active') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles editRole INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions editGrant ON editGrant.roleId=editRole.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions editPermission ON editPermission.id=editGrant.permissionId AND editPermission.permissionCode='workflows.edit' AND editPermission.isActive=1 WHERE editRole.userId=:permissionUserId AND editRole.tenantId=w.tenantId AND editRole.isActive=1)

SELECT w.id,w.workflowName,w.referenceCode,w.eventStatusId,es.statusName AS status,w.ownerTeamId,w.startDate,w.targetDate,w.locationId,w.spaceId,w.configurationId,w.rowVersion,w.modifiedDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown user') AS modifiedByUserName FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_event_statuses es ON es.id=w.eventStatusId AND es.tenantId=w.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=w.modifiedByUserId WHERE w.id=:id AND w.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenants membership WHERE membership.userId=:userId AND membership.tenantId=w.tenantId AND membership.isActive=1 AND membership.membershipStatus='active') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles editRole INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions editGrant ON editGrant.roleId=editRole.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions editPermission ON editPermission.id=editGrant.permissionId AND editPermission.permissionCode='workflows.edit' AND editPermission.isActive=1 WHERE editRole.userId=:userId AND editRole.tenantId=w.tenantId AND editRole.isActive=1) LIMIT 1

sql.query: UPDATE tbl_workflow_field_values fv INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=fv.workflowId AND w.tenantId=fv.tenantId SET fv.valueDate=CASE WHEN fv.fieldKey='show_date' THEN NULLIF(:showDate,'') ELSE fv.valueDate END,fv.valueText=CASE WHEN fv.fieldKey='show_time' THEN NULLIF(:showTime,'') ELSE fv.valueText END,fv.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE fv.workflowId=:workflowId AND fv.tenantId=:tenantId AND fv.fieldKey IN ('show_date','show_time') AND :affectedRows=1

INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,beforeJson,afterJson,createdDate) SELECT :tenantId,:userId,:workflowId,'workflow',:entityId,CASE WHEN :oldStatus<>:newStatus THEN 'workflow.status_changed' ELSE 'workflow.updated' END,CASE WHEN :oldStatus2<>:newStatus2 THEN CONCAT(:displayName,' changed ',:workflowName,' from ',REPLACE(:oldStatus3,'_',' '),' to ',REPLACE(:newStatus3,'_',' ')) ELSE CONCAT(:displayName,' updated ',:workflowName2) END,JSON_OBJECT('version',:oldVersion,'workflowName',:oldName,'referenceCode',:oldReference,'status',:oldStatus4,'ownerTeamId',:oldTeam,'startDate',:oldStart,'targetDate',:oldTarget),JSON_OBJECT('version',:newVersion,'workflowName',:newName,'referenceCode',:newReference,'status',:newStatus4,'ownerTeamId',:newTeam,'startDate',:newStart,'targetDate',:newTarget),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_activity_types activityType WHERE activityType.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND activityType.activityKey=CASE WHEN :oldStatus5<>:newStatus5 THEN 'workflow.status_changed' ELSE 'workflow.updated' END AND activityType.isActive=1 AND :affectedRows=1 LIMIT 1
